name: Cross-check a claim with independent sources
short_description: Cross-check a claim with independent sources once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can cross-check a claim with independent sources in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Cross-check a claim with independent sources means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Cross-check a claim with independent sources in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Reconcile details across three sources helps develop cross-check a claim with independent sources but is not indispensable.
